lines.when: a body check with Strength under 0.4 (NEW situation: needs a picker rule like shot.soft)
lines.text: A tap on the shoulder. Rude, but a tap.

lines.when: a body check with Strength under 0.4 (NEW situation: needs a picker rule like shot.soft)
lines.text: Just a nudge. The real one is coming.

lines.when: a body check with Strength under 0.4 (NEW situation: needs a picker rule like shot.soft)
lines.text: Polite little bump.

lines.when: a body check with Strength under 0.4 (NEW situation: needs a picker rule like shot.soft)
lines.text: He felt that about as much as a breeze.

lines.when: a body check with Strength under 0.4 (NEW situation: needs a picker rule like shot.soft)
lines.text: Shoulder to shoulder. Warming up.

lines.when: a body check with Strength under 0.4 (NEW situation: needs a picker rule like shot.soft)
lines.text: That one was a hello.

lines.when: a body check with Strength 0.4 to under 0.8 (NEW situation)
lines.text: That one rattled the glass.

lines.when: a body check with Strength 0.4 to under 0.8 (NEW situation)
lines.text: Now he knows where the boards are.

lines.when: a body check with Strength 0.4 to under 0.8 (NEW situation)
lines.text: Square hit. Clean and loud.

lines.when: a body check with Strength 0.4 to under 0.8 (NEW situation)
lines.text: Lays the body and walks away.

lines.when: a body check with Strength 0.4 to under 0.8 (NEW situation)
lines.text: Hell of a hit.

lines.when: a body check with Strength 0.4 to under 0.8 (NEW situation)
lines.text: Shoulders, hips, and a lot of gravity.

lines.when: a body check with Strength 0.4 to under 0.8 (NEW situation)
lines.text: That is how you carry the check.

lines.when: a knockdown whose check had Strength 0.8 or more (NEW situation; knockdown carries the check Strength)
lines.text: Flattened! Somebody check the ice for dents.

lines.when: a knockdown whose check had Strength 0.8 or more (NEW situation; knockdown carries the check Strength)
lines.text: Sent flying, and the puck stayed behind.

lines.when: a knockdown whose check had Strength 0.8 or more (NEW situation; knockdown carries the check Strength)
lines.text: Folded in half and set down gently. Not gently.

lines.when: a knockdown whose check had Strength 0.8 or more (NEW situation; knockdown carries the check Strength)
lines.text: Planted him like a flag.

lines.when: a knockdown whose check had Strength 0.8 or more (NEW situation; knockdown carries the check Strength)
lines.text: He is wearing the boards now.

lines.when: a knockdown whose check had Strength 0.8 or more (NEW situation; knockdown carries the check Strength)
lines.text: Gravity wins again.

lines.when: a knockdown whose check had Strength 0.8 or more (NEW situation; knockdown carries the check Strength)
lines.text: The ice has a new best friend.

lines.when: a cross-check lands (NEW Kind: the sim emits Kind "cross" on the check and its knockdown; today Kind is only "check" or "boost")
lines.text: Stick across the chest! That is a cross-check.

lines.when: a cross-check lands (NEW Kind: the sim emits Kind "cross" on the check and its knockdown; today Kind is only "check" or "boost")
lines.text: Cross-check, and he sits down hard.

lines.when: a cross-check lands (NEW Kind: the sim emits Kind "cross" on the check and its knockdown; today Kind is only "check" or "boost")
lines.text: Bowled over with the shaft.

lines.when: a cross-check lands (NEW Kind: the sim emits Kind "cross" on the check and its knockdown; today Kind is only "check" or "boost")
lines.text: Cross-check! Nobody saw that coming. He did not.

lines.when: a cross-check lands (NEW Kind: the sim emits Kind "cross" on the check and its knockdown; today Kind is only "check" or "boost")
lines.text: Wood across the middle. Down he goes.

lines.when: a cross-check lands (NEW Kind: the sim emits Kind "cross" on the check and its knockdown; today Kind is only "check" or "boost")
lines.text: The cross-check does the talking.

lines.when: a cross-check lands (NEW Kind: the sim emits Kind "cross" on the check and its knockdown; today Kind is only "check" or "boost")
lines.text: Sent sprawling by a cross-check.

lines.when: a cross-check lands (NEW Kind: the sim emits Kind "cross" on the check and its knockdown; today Kind is only "check" or "boost")
lines.text: Damn, that cross-check had a lot of mustard.

lines.when: a cross-check lands (NEW Kind: the sim emits Kind "cross" on the check and its knockdown; today Kind is only "check" or "boost")
lines.text: He ran into the stick and the ice caught him.

lines.when: a cross-check lands (NEW Kind: the sim emits Kind "cross" on the check and its knockdown; today Kind is only "check" or "boost")
lines.text: Cross-check! The glass felt that too.

lines.when: the human skater is knocked down (existing situation, ids 04 to 13 would extend knockdown.human.01..03)
lines.text: You are down. Count the lights, then get up.

lines.when: the human skater is knocked down (existing situation, ids 04 to 13 would extend knockdown.human.01..03)
lines.text: The ice caught you. Shake it off.

lines.when: the human skater is knocked down (existing situation, ids 04 to 13 would extend knockdown.human.01..03)
lines.text: Good hit. Now go give one back.

lines.when: the human skater is knocked down (existing situation, ids 04 to 13 would extend knockdown.human.01..03)
lines.text: Up you get. They are not done.

lines.when: the human skater is knocked down (existing situation, ids 04 to 13 would extend knockdown.human.01..03)
lines.text: That one had your name on it. Go answer.

lines.when: the human skater is knocked down (existing situation, ids 04 to 13 would extend knockdown.human.01..03)
lines.text: Flat on the ice. It happens to the best of us.

lines.when: the human skater is knocked down (existing situation, ids 04 to 13 would extend knockdown.human.01..03)
lines.text: Sit a second. Then go find him.

lines.when: the human skater is knocked down (existing situation, ids 04 to 13 would extend knockdown.human.01..03)
lines.text: That one is going on the wall. Now answer it.

lines.when: the human skater is knocked down (existing situation, ids 04 to 13 would extend knockdown.human.01..03)
lines.text: Folded. Back up, there is a puck to chase.

lines.when: the human skater is knocked down (existing situation, ids 04 to 13 would extend knockdown.human.01..03)
lines.text: Rolled right over you. Time to return the favour.

lines.when: the third knockdown by one team within 1200 frames (20 s) (NEW; the bank cannot express a count in a window: the picker needs a per-team ring of knockdown frames)
lines.text: Three down in a flash. This is a massacre shift.

lines.when: the third knockdown by one team within 1200 frames (20 s) (NEW; the bank cannot express a count in a window: the picker needs a per-team ring of knockdown frames)
lines.text: They are bowling out there. Strike after strike.

lines.when: the third knockdown by one team within 1200 frames (20 s) (NEW; the bank cannot express a count in a window: the picker needs a per-team ring of knockdown frames)
lines.text: Another one down. The ice is getting crowded.

lines.when: the third knockdown by one team within 1200 frames (20 s) (NEW; the bank cannot express a count in a window: the picker needs a per-team ring of knockdown frames)
lines.text: Nobody is standing. Well, nearly nobody.

lines.when: the third knockdown by one team within 1200 frames (20 s) (NEW; the bank cannot express a count in a window: the picker needs a per-team ring of knockdown frames)
lines.text: Hit after hit after hit. What a shift.

lines.when: the third knockdown by one team within 1200 frames (20 s) (NEW; the bank cannot express a count in a window: the picker needs a per-team ring of knockdown frames)
lines.text: They are going through the other team like a lawn mower.

lines.when: the third knockdown by one team within 1200 frames (20 s) (NEW; the bank cannot express a count in a window: the picker needs a per-team ring of knockdown frames)
lines.text: Down, down, and down again.

lines.when: the third knockdown by one team within 1200 frames (20 s) (NEW; the bank cannot express a count in a window: the picker needs a per-team ring of knockdown frames)
lines.text: This is not hockey, this is a wrecking yard.

lines.when: the third knockdown by one team within 1200 frames (20 s) (NEW; the bank cannot express a count in a window: the picker needs a per-team ring of knockdown frames)
lines.text: Pile them up! Somebody sweep the ice.

lines.when: the third knockdown by one team within 1200 frames (20 s) (NEW; the bank cannot express a count in a window: the picker needs a per-team ring of knockdown frames)
lines.text: The shift of the night, and the night is young.

lines.when: a goal within 300 frames after the scoring team landed a check (NEW situation, like board.bank evaluated at the goal)
lines.text: Hit him, take the puck, score. Simple.

lines.when: a goal within 300 frames after the scoring team landed a check (NEW situation, like board.bank evaluated at the goal)
lines.text: The check made the goal.

lines.when: a goal within 300 frames after the scoring team landed a check (NEW situation, like board.bank evaluated at the goal)
lines.text: Flatten, grab, fire. That is a goal.

lines.when: a goal within 300 frames after the scoring team landed a check (NEW situation, like board.bank evaluated at the goal)
lines.text: He went down and the net went in.

lines.when: a goal within 300 frames after the scoring team landed a check (NEW situation, like board.bank evaluated at the goal)
lines.text: The hit paid off in full.

lines.when: a goal within 300 frames after the scoring team landed a check (NEW situation, like board.bank evaluated at the goal)
lines.text: Lays the body, lights the lamp.

lines.when: a goal within 300 frames after the scoring team landed a check (NEW situation, like board.bank evaluated at the goal)
lines.text: Rough work, pretty finish.

lines.when: a goal within 300 frames after the scoring team landed a check (NEW situation, like board.bank evaluated at the goal)
lines.text: One hit, one goal. Efficient.

lines.when: a goal within 300 frames after the scoring team landed a check (NEW situation, like board.bank evaluated at the goal)
lines.text: The ice shook and the net followed.

lines.when: a goal within 300 frames after the scoring team landed a check (NEW situation, like board.bank evaluated at the goal)
lines.text: That goal started with a shoulder.
